Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 훈련을 하던 중, 줄넘기에 몸이 묶여 버렸다...

Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>在训练时，身体被跳绳缠住了…
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>在訓練時，身體被跳繩纏住了…

Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Trong lúc tập luyện, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã bị dây nhảy quấn quanh người...
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ट्रेनिंग के दौरान रस्सी में उलझ गई...

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Ajude Elisa a se livrar das cordas.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I freed <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> and we continued training.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>を縄からほどいて、トレーニングを続けた。

Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Ich befreite <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> und wir setzten das Training fort.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ฉันช่วย <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ให้หลุดจากเชือก แล้วเราก็ฝึกกันต่อ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Aku membebaskan <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dan kami melanjutkan latihan.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Tôi đã giải thoát <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> và tiếp tục huấn luyện.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: मैंने <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> को आज़ाद किया और हमने ट्रेनिंग जारी रखी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I tried to help, but <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>'s flailing made it worse...
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 縄をほどこうとしたが、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>のもがきで失敗した…。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 本想帮她解开绳子，却因<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>挣扎而失败了…
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 本想幫她解開繩子，卻因<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>掙扎而失敗了…
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: J'ai essayé de dénouer la corde, mais les agitations de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ont rendu l'effort infructueux...
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Ich versuchte zu helfen, aber <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>s Herumzappeln machte es nur schlimmer...
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Intenté desatar la cuerda, pero los forcejeos de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hicieron que fallara...
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Tentei soltar a corda, mas falhei porque <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> não parava de se debater...
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ฉันพยายามจะช่วยแกะเชือก แต่ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดิ้นไปมาจนแย่กว่าเดิม...
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Aku mencoba melepaskan tali, tetapi <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> malah membuatnya semakin memburuk...
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Tôi đã cố gắng giúp, nhưng <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> cứ quẫy đạp làm mọi thứ tệ hơn...
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: मैंने मदद करने की कोशिश की, लेकिन <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> के हाथ-पैर मारने से बात और बिगड़ गई...

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 줄을 풀다가 잠들어 버린 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(와)과 함께 휴식을 취했다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: While untying the rope, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> fell asleep, and I rested beside her.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 縄をほどいているうちに眠ってしまった<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>と一緒に休息を取った。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 最终与在解绳过程中睡着的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>一同休息了。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 最終與在解繩過程中睡著的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>一同休息了。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: En démêlant la corde, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est endormie, et je me suis reposé à ses côtés.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Beim Entwirren des Seils schlief <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ein, und ich ruhte mich neben ihr aus.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Mientras desataba la cuerda, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se durmió y tomé un descanso a su lado.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Descansaste com <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, que adormeceu enquanto tentava desatar a corda.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ระหว่างที่กำลังแกะเชือก <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็หลับไป ฉันเลยพักอยู่ข้าง ๆ เธอ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Saat melepaskan tali, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tertidur, dan aku beristirahat di sampingnya.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Trong lúc gỡ dây, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã ngủ thiếp đi, và tôi nghỉ ngơi bên cạnh cô ấy.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: रस्सी खोलते समय, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> सो गई, और मैं उसके बगल में आराम करने लगा।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 결국 줄을 풀지 못한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(을)를 도와줘야 했다...
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: In the end, I had to help <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> out of the ropes...
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 結局、縄をほどけなかった<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>を助けるしかなかった…。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 最后还是得帮助无法自己解开绳子的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>…
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 最後還是得幫助無法自己解開繩子的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>…
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Finalement, j'ai dû aider <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> à se libérer des liens...
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Am Ende musste ich <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> aus den Seilen helfen...
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Al final, tuve que ayudar a <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a salir de las cuerdas...
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: No final, tiveste de ajudar <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, que não conseguiu desatar a corda...
Data.UnitTalk_THA: สุดท้ายฉันก็ต้องช่วย <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ให้หลุดจากเชือกอยู่ดี...
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Pada akhirnya, aku harus membantu <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> melepaskan diri dari tali...
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Cuối cùng, tôi phải giúp <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thoát khỏi dây trói...
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: आखिरकार, मुझे <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> की मदद करनी ही पड़ी…

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 포션을 마신 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 가볍게 줄을 풀고 일어났다!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After drinking the potion, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> easily untangled herself and stood up!
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: ポーションを飲んだ<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、軽々と縄をほどいて立ち上がった！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 喝下药水的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>轻松解开绳子站了起来！
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 喝下藥水的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>輕鬆解開繩子站了起來！
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir bu la potion, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est facilement démêlée et s'est levée !
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nachdem sie den Trank getrunken hatte, befreite sich <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mühelos und stand auf!
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Después de beber la poción, ¡<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se desenredó fácilmente y se puso de pie!
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Depois de beber a poção, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> desatou a corda facilmente e levantou-se!
Data.UnitTalk_THA: หลังจากดื่มยา <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็แกะเชือกออกได้อย่างง่ายดายแล้วลุกขึ้นยืน!
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah meminum ramuan, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dengan mudah melepaskan diri dan berdiri!
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi uống thuốc, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dễ dàng gỡ rối và đứng dậy!
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: औषधि पीने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने आसानी से खुद को सुलझाया और खड़ी हो गई!
